name: Smart Lamp
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A configurable lamp: a USB LEDs module for light, a button to switch it on/off (long-press for a 30-minute sundown fade), one knob for brightness and one for colour, and a buzzer for confirmation sounds. Remembers its last setting.
assembly_guide: Connect the USB LEDs module to the DataHub, and the DataHub to the PicoHub.
Connect the LED Button, both Knobs and the Buzzer to the PicoHub I2C ports.
Run setup in the noknok app — you'll be asked which button and which knob does what.

roles.prompt: Press the button you want to use to switch the lamp on and off
Turn the knob you want to use for brightness
Turn the knob you want to use for colour

config_schema.label: Lamp colour
config_schema.help: The colour knob steps through 64 preset colours; pick any colour here.

config_schema.label: Sundown fade
config_schema.help: Hold the power button for one second to start the fade.
